text: Test 2 This is the IELTS listening test. You will hear a number of different recordings and you will have to answer questions on what you hear. There will be time for you to read the instructions and questions and you will have a chance to check your work. All the recordings will be played once only. The test is in four parts. At the end of the test, you will be given ten minutes to transfer your answers to an answer sheet. Now turn to part one. Part one You will hear a woman from a job agency giving information to a man about work in a chain of restaurants. First you have some time to look at questions one to five. Now, look at questions one to five. Now, listen carefully and answer questions one to five.
Now listen and answer questions six to ten.
